description: Questions Audora's reviewers asked about the artist's releases (for example, whether the rights to a remix are cleared), with the whole conversation. A release with an unanswered question does not go out until the artist answers. Omit release_id for every open question.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

release_id.description: One release, including a closed conversation. Omit for all open questions.

name: get_release_questions
title: What Audora has asked the artist
